parent: Actual 27fbb2a M56 alert-surface Git release tree (164 files) as the M30 parent: the milestone that closed the written-plan gate and parsed the stored alert verdict. It already computes order blocks and stores the trader’s settings; what it does not do is give the zone a second geometry, a way to choose it, or a name. This milestone adds no FILE and no schema object.

feature.scope: REPORTED completed assertions; literal clocks, saved rows, HTTP and a real DOM only. Ep 7 gives TWO zone methods — the PIVOT method (the single candle before the displacement) and the RANGE method (the whole consolidation high-to-low) — and the app shipped one of them, hardcoded, with no way to say which geometry a read used let alone choose the other. The range method is now computed by a closed three-rule walk (a displacement bar ends the base, a bar that does not overlap it is the departure, a 3-ATR cap is REPORTED), the method is a closed vocabulary (`pivot` default, `range`), a read NAMES the geometry it ran on and where the choice came from, and the choice is stored in the settings JSON that already exists. NO new schema object, no new file, no write on a read, no broker/mental/pixel/production proof, and NO performance claim: the wider zone is stated as a trade-off (wider zone, wider stop) in both the payload and the screens, never as a winner. RAW failures/early aborts and DECLARED assumptions stay separate. DECLARED NEGATIVE carried here by name: the inherited M99/M101 reviews cohort is STALE at this HEAD — 157/3 against its committed 159/1, because the schema grew after M101; the three gaps are declared, not repaired in the probe.

regression_parents.method: Actual 9c88e0a M12 Git release as the M13/M65 parent (the milestone these periods sit on), plus the M112 cohort’s and the inherited reviews cohort’s own measured parent maps, inherited unchanged — no parent is re-derived here and no schema or module is read out of an older runner.

controls.parent_tree: the committed 27fbb2a M56 release: no zone-method vocabulary, the `?zone_method=` query ignored, the settings write silently dropped, no picker and no note — five probes 0/1 each, the mode-aware control 11/0
controls.module_only_tree: the parent plus `src/bots/smc.js` alone: the vocabulary, the folding rule and the three-rule consolidation walk exist and are measured working (pure 27/0, control 11/0) while the filter block, the routes, the settings key and both screens know nothing about them (engine 8/3, api 3/2, ui 1/1, migration 15/7)
controls.why: The staged fault is a geometry nothing can CHOOSE or NAME around a working zone engine: that is why the pure and control arms pass on the module-only tree while the engine, api, ui and migration arms fail on the absence the milestone closes.

geometry.walk: backwards from the SAME pivot candle the pivot method anchors on, over closed bars, stopping on a displacement bar (range >= 1.2 x ATR and body/range >= 0.55), a bar that does not overlap the envelope (price left the base), a REPORTED cap (3 x ATR / 12 bars, `capped:true`), or the start of history
geometry.fallback: a walk shorter than two bars is `no_consolidation` and the zone stays PIVOT with its reason; the count is published as `base_fallbacks`
geometry.no_influence: no grade, score, cap or price is moved by the choice itself (measured: with nothing chosen the candidates are byte-identical to the parent’s); the wider zone IS a wider stop, stated as a trade-off on the payload and on both screens
geometry.storage: read from the existing `users.settings` JSON; no table, no column, no index, no trigger, no backfill, and a read writes nothing it did not write before (the read-write set over two reads is identical to the parent’s own set)

strength_term.fires_on: 21% of order blocks in the measured windows (54 of 259)

doc_corrections.API: docs/API.md gains the `zone_method` query on analyse/chart/scan, the settings key on `PUT /settings`, and a section naming the two geometries, the closed source vocabulary, the reported caps and the trade-off
doc_corrections.PLAYLIST-CURRICULUM row 7: the Supply & demand row no longer reads as one hardcoded rectangle: it names both of his methods, the default, where the choice lives and that every read names the geometry it used
doc_corrections.NOT-IMPLEMENTED: a new row names what works AND what is NOT claimed (the consolidation is this app’s definition with reported caps; neither method is measured to be better; the stop behind a wider zone is further away)

scope: M30 the two zone methods: Ep 7’s range geometry built as a closed three-rule walk over the consolidation (caps reported), the pivot method kept as the DEFAULT, the geometry a closed vocabulary with a named provenance (`request`/`settings`/`unspecified`/`default`), the choice stored in the settings JSON that already exists, and the strength term for `tests >= 2` restored beside the fresh-zone bonus. Explicitly NOT claimed: that either geometry is better, that the mechanical consolidation is his discretionary range, a performance or expectancy claim from the strength term, a pixel proof, or anything about a real account.
